baselineDisplay.title: Goodbye and Good Luck
baselineDisplay.question: Where is Captain Alison going and how?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 艾莉森上尉要去哪里？怎么去？
baselineDisplay.text:
Where is Captain Alison going and how?

Our neighbour, Captain Charles Alison, will sail from Portsmouth tomorrow.
We'll meet him at the harbour early in the morning.
He will be in his small boat, Topsail.
Topsail is a famous little boat.
It has sailed across the Atlantic many times.
Captain Alison will set out at eight o'clock, so we'll have plenty of time.
We'll see his boat and then we'll say goodbye to him.
He will be away for two months.
We are very proud of him.
He will take part in an important race across the Atlantic.

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
我们的邻居查尔斯·艾利森上尉明天将从朴次茅斯启航。
我们将在清晨在港口与他见面。
他会待在他的小船'托普赛尔'号上。
“Topsail”是一艘非常著名的小船。
它已经多次横渡了大西洋。
艾莉森船长八点就要出发了，所以我们会有足够的时间。
我们会去看看他的船，然后跟他告别。
他将会离开两个月。
我们为他感到非常骄傲。
他将参加一场横跨大西洋的重要比赛。

corrections.evidence: 00:16.15同名Charles Alison中译艾利森，00:39.48 Captain Alison已译船长；全课为驾驶Topsail参赛语境，统一名称与职称。
00:39.48同一个Captain Alison对应船长，00:27.51驾驶自己的船且00:55.91参加跨洋比赛，没有军事身份陈述。
00:16.15全名Charles Alison中译为查尔斯·艾利森，与00:39.48同一个Alison，统一音译。

notes: 通读Alison航海送行故事，核对Portsmouth、Topsail、八点、两个月和横跨大西洋比赛。Captain在同课01处已译船长且无军职背景，统一另外两处上尉误译；Alison按首句艾利森统一，保留船名与英式harbour。
